_notes: Vanilla 1.21.11 fluid scenarios from mcdecomp/harness/src/FluidDump.java. Setup fills place blocks without updates. Each tick runs like a server tick: the tick's actions (Level.setBlock(pos, state, 3)) happen first, at the previous game time, then the game time advances to the tick and its fluid ticks run (tick 0 only runs actions). Checkpoints hold the box's blocks after the given tick: one string per (y, z) row, y then z ascending, with a character per x giving the block's palette index in 0-9a-zA-Z.

scenarios.name: water_flat
scenarios.description: A water source on open stone spreads seven blocks, five ticks per step.

scenarios.name: water_slope_to_hole
scenarios.description: Water and lava only flow toward a hole at exactly their slope distance (4 and 2 blocks away).

scenarios.name: waterfall_and_decay
scenarios.description: Water falls off a ledge and spreads below, then dries up once its source is removed.

scenarios.name: water_source_conversion
scenarios.description: A flowing cell between two sources over stone becomes a source; one over air doesn't.

scenarios.name: lava_and_water
scenarios.description: Lava and water meet: flowing lava turns to cobblestone, a lava source to obsidian, lava over water to stone.

scenarios.name: nether_fast_lava_and_basalt
scenarios.description: Fast lava spreads farther and quicker; lava over soul soil next to blue ice becomes basalt.

scenarios.name: waterlogged_and_obstacles
scenarios.description: Water flows out of a waterlogged slab and through open stairs, but not into dry slabs, fences or doors, and replaces fire.
